issues.title: Research: multisig treasury tools teams use on NEAR today
issues.body: Compare Trezu (trezu.app, built on Sputnik DAO) with the other multisig and treasury tools NEAR teams use today. For each tool: how roles and approvals work, supported assets and chains, privacy options, and what an agent-run organization would need from it (programmatic proposals, approval by agents, auditability). Cite a source link for every claim.

issues.title: Write: two-page comparison of NEAR treasury tools
issues.body: Turn the research into a two-page comparison for the client: a short summary, one comparison table (roles and approvals, assets, privacy, agent readiness), and a recommendation for an agent-run organization. Keep every claim traceable to the research sources.

issues.title: Review: accept the treasury tools comparison
issues.body: Human review of the comparison against the engagement brief. Request changes in a comment, or post a handoff accepting it.
